headline: Baba Ramdev claims Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Afghanistan will become part of India
summary: The Indian yoga guru asserted that these three neighboring countries will eventually be integrated into India one day.
details: Indian yoga guru Baba Ramdev has sparked controversy with his latest claims regarding the geopolitical future of South Asia.
He stated that Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Afghanistan will one day become part of India, suggesting a future unification of the region.
Ramdev's remarks come as part of his broader views on the historical and cultural ties between these nations.
The comments have drawn attention due to the sensitive nature of national sovereignty and borders in the region.
caption:
Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Afghanistan will one day be part of India, claims Baba Ramdev.

Indian yoga guru Baba Ramdev has sparked controversy with his latest claims regarding the geopolitical future of South Asia.

He stated that Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Afghanistan will one day become part of India, suggesting a future unification of the region.

Ramdev's remarks come as part of his broader views on the historical and cultural ties between these nations.

The comments have drawn attention due to the sensitive nature of national sovereignty and borders in the region.

headline: Storm alert: 4 sea ports put on signal 3 as coastal winds rise
summary: Authorities have issued warnings for four sea ports as the risk of stormy winds along the coast increases.
details: Four sea ports in Bangladesh have been placed on danger signal number 3 due to the risk of stormy winds along the coastal areas.
The warning indicates a potential for increased wind speed and rough sea conditions, prompting authorities to take precautionary measures.
Residents and mariners in thecoastal regions are advised to remain vigilant and follow safety guidelines to minimize risks associated with the storm.
The signal is a standard procedure used by the meteorological department to notify the ports and ships of impending weather threats.
caption:
Storm alert! 4 sea ports are now on signal 3 as coastal winds intensify.

Four sea ports in Bangladesh have been placed on danger signal number 3 due to the risk of stormy winds along the coastal areas.

The warning indicates a potential for increased wind speed and rough sea conditions, prompting authorities to take precautionary measures.

Residents and mariners in thecoastal regions are advised to remain vigilant and follow safety guidelines to minimize risks associated with the storm.

The signal is a standard procedure used by the meteorological department to notify the ports and ships of impending weather threats.
